summary: Re-recording a sign-off this project already gave on 2026-07-24, on the mainline where the pin was never written. Scope is unchanged from 0010: this is the harness's own repository and maintainer plan approval is the sign-off. The interrogation found one blocking gap in the handover itself — the brief was still the unfilled template — which was fixed before this grill was recorded. Three further gaps are real but specific to a harness maintenance repo and are parked as non-blocking.
gaps: docs/product/BRIEF.md was the unfilled scaffold: '## Summary' read 'One paragraph on what is being built and why now' and users were 'primary user type'. The central handover document said nothing about the product.

Only one confirmed capability spec exists (docs/specs/delegation-boundary.md) for a repo that has already shipped the delegation boundary, the legacy upgrade, the board, and the gate chain. Most shipped capability is specified in WORKFLOW.md and AGENTS.md rather than as confirmed specs.

plans/roadmap.json on this branch holds one story and it is done, so sign-off is being recorded over a line with no pending derived scope. The work it will gate (FORGE-LOCK-1 and the project-hierarchy stories) is on chore/codify-process-rules.
docs/product/DISCOVERY.md does not exist; the repo predates its own phase-0 ceremony.
resolutions: The brief was written from README.md, AGENTS.md and WORKFLOW.md and committed as 3626113 before this grill was recorded, so the handover now states the product, its users, flows, domain concepts, constraints and non-goals.
0019-client-signoff records why a superseded 0010 left the mainline unsigned and states that 0014 remains the governing rule; there is no live contradiction between the two records.
open_items: non-blocking: the harness's own shipped capabilities are under-specified as capability specs. Retro-fitting specs for already-shipped machinery would be archaeology, not planning; the constraint applies to new capabilities from here.
non-blocking: this branch's roadmap converges with chore/codify-process-rules on merge, where FORGE-DELEG-1 done, FORGE-UPG-1 active and FORGE-LOCK-1 pending already sit.
non-blocking: no DISCOVERY.md — this repo's discovery record is README.md, WORKFLOW.md and docs/harness-philosophy.md. Revisit only if the harness ever runs a full product phase-0 on itself.
